chapter_2_opening.title: ONE EVENT BECOMES FIVE PROBLEMS
chapter_2_opening.description: Only the first 15 seconds of Chapter 2 are in the active scope: the supplier exception begins spreading into Operations and the first Supply consequence begins.

supersede_rule: The Operations-only 60-second contract remains historical evidence but MUST NOT drive the current investor-film generation. This later owner checkpoint is authoritative for 00:00-01:00.

beats.picture: Black first. Location sound arrives before picture. Dawn over a believable tropical city, then descend into loading bays, hotel corridors, restaurant prep, an accounting desk and service vehicles waking up.
beats.narration: Before a company becomes a number, it is thousands of small promises being kept.
beats.visual_rule: Premium physical business reality first; no software exposition.

beats.picture: Match-cut a delivery seal, hotel-room key, chef checking prep, technician closing a van door and stage lights testing. Every promise is physical and role-correct.
beats.narration: A room ready. A table booked. A job on time. A supplier who said yes. A customer who expects the business to remember.
beats.visual_rule: Fast, tactile, human, cinematic match cuts; no generic stock smiles.

beats.picture: Show re-entry, calls, context chasing and an accountant waiting for the operating reason. Fragmentation is felt through work and delay rather than a feature montage.
beats.narration: Most companies already have software. That is not the problem. The problem is that every part of the company learns reality separately.
beats.visual_rule: No dashboard montage, no fake UI, no feature grid, no abstract AI graphics.

beats.picture: A time-critical supplier truck arrives. Receiving counts a key delivery. One item is missing and another is wrong. The receiver checks the physical label twice. No melodrama; let the ordinary exception land.
beats.narration: And then something ordinary happens. One delivery is wrong.
beats.visual_rule: The supplier exception is the inciting event, not the primary showcase or definition of Avantiqo.

beats.picture: Operations learns first. Kitchen and service readiness no longer fit tonight's commitment; people keep working while the consequence becomes visible.
beats.narration: To Operations, it is a service problem.
beats.visual_rule: Human work stays primary; show the operational consequence before any later product reveal.

beats.picture: Begin the transition into Supply: replacement availability, lead time and cost are now implicated. Cut cleanly at 01:00 so Chapter 2 can continue without reset.
beats.narration: To Supply, it is availability, lead time and another decision.
beats.narration_delivery: The line may begin in this window and continue naturally beyond 01:00 in the full master; do not unnaturally compress the voice to finish before the active cut.
beats.visual_rule: End on an edit-safe continuation point, not a standalone-film ending.
